# 9xenai

> 9xenai is an AI automation, consulting and software agency based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It builds WhatsApp and web chatbots, AI voice agents, workflow automation and enterprise AI for businesses in Bangladesh, the USA, Canada, Australia, Europe and the Gulf. Fixed-scope pilots, human-approved automation, prices in US dollars.

Brand name: 9xenai (also written 9xenai AI). Website: https://9xenai.online/

## Key pages
- [Services](https://9xenai.online/services/): 25 AI practices
- [Pricing](https://9xenai.online/pricing/): chatbots from $1,000, workflow automation from $1,500, voice agents from $2,000, managed plans from $500 a month
- [Enterprise assurance](https://9xenai.online/enterprise/)
- [Service levels](https://9xenai.online/sla/)
- [Contact](https://9xenai.online/contact/)
